changes: New optional Class Colors theme adds full-row class color to arena, nearby and battleground enemies, even with low, unknown or hidden health.
Highground: `/hg theme classcolors`. Standalones: Arena `/hga theme classcolors`, Nearby `/hgn theme classcolors`, Bounties `/hgb theme classcolors`.
Custom class colors and saved layout settings are respected. Text and target/focus cues stay readable, and themes can switch in combat.
For the dark panel palette: Highground `/hg theme classcolors`, standalone Battlegrounds `/hgbg theme classcolors`, standalone Macros `/hgm theme classcolors`.
notice: Restart WoW after updating; the new theme file cannot load with /reload alone. CurseForge files may still be in moderation.
